resources.string: Advanced: these commands run ADB shell actions on the current target and may change device behavior.
✅ Ready to Install APKs\n\nOpen any APK file and select anyapk

⚠️ Setup Required

Step 1: Enable Developer Options
 • Open Settings → About Phone
 • Tap "Build Number" 7 times
 • You'll see "You are now a developer!"

Step 2: Enable Wireless Debugging
 • Go to Settings → Developer Options
 • Enable "Wireless debugging"

Step 3: Pair with anyapk
 • Tap "Enter Pairing Code" below

⚠️ Pairing Required

Steps:
1. Tap "Enter Pairing Code" below
2. Go to Settings → Developer Options → Wireless Debugging
3. Tap "Pair device with pairing code"
4. Swipe down from top to see the notification
5. Tap "Reply" and enter: CODE PORT
 Example: 123456 37829

⚠️ Pairing Required

1. Enable "Wireless debugging" in Developer Options
2. Tap "Enter Pairing Code" below
3. Follow pairing instructions

📱 IMPORTANT: Use Split Screen!

1. Tap the Recent Apps button (square)
2. Long-press on Settings, select "Open in split screen view"
3. Select anyapk for the other half
4. In Settings: Developer Options → Wireless Debugging
5. Tap "Pair device with pairing code"
6. Enter the code and port below

With split screen, the pairing dialog stays visible!
After pairing, you should see an \"Allow USB debugging?\" prompt. Tap \"Always allow from this computer\" then \"Allow\".
